diary.text: I expected plugs and wifi to matter most. Noor talked about being anonymous instead, which I had not planned to ask about.
Priya didn't choose the café; their employer did. Check whether 'an office they choose' still holds, or whether choice is the wrong word.
Two people now say a café is pleasant only while nobody knows them. That sits oddly next to Noor missing the man who nods. Maybe being seen is fine, being spoken to is not.
